name: gaea-coordinated-query-cancellation-across-4df3
instr:
Gaea cannot cancel an active client query by stable identifier without risking the session or unrelated work. Implement cancellation across backend execution, results, connections, and MySQL responses without changing uncancelled commands. Package `github.com/XiaoMi/Gaea/util` exposes `RequestContext.QueryID`, `RequestContext.Cancel`, and `RequestContext.Cancellation`; `github.com/XiaoMi/Gaea/backend` exposes `CancellationOutcome` and `CancellationResult`; `github.com/XiaoMi/Gaea/proxy/server` exposes `CancelStatus`, `QueryRegistry`, `NewQueryRegistry`, `QueryRegistry.Register`, `QueryRegistry.Cancel`, `QueryRegistry.Complete`, and `SessionExecutor.CancelQuery`; and `github.com/XiaoMi/Gaea/mysql` exposes `CancellationError` with fields `QueryID uint64; Cause error`. Preserve uncancelled sharded and unsharded results, merging, metadata, errors, and session side effects.

Give every executing command a distinct nonzero identity that remains stable through its single terminal response. Make cancellation monotonic and visible once throughout its request context. Distinguish accepted, finished, and unknown targets. Remove targets on completion, disconnect, and namespace reload so identifiers cannot affect later work.

Cancel every active backend leg and wait until each finishes or becomes unusable. Report whether execution stopped, had completed, or lost its connection before confirmation. Each connection must have one observable ownership outcome: reusable once only when known sa
